name: net_client_hit_claims
description: Protocol v3 D4 native acceptance: real local-player combos from each client, immutable connection/sequence/typed target correlation to exactly-once host native attempts, at least one exact nonlethal host HP delta per attacker, then strict applied native HP/death/progress parity. Starts with nonempty typed enemy parity; unmatched courtyard/refill populations remain failures. Host receives no attack inputs or manual damage commands. Offline prepared only; not live-validated; does not establish boss finisher/attack-specific effects or reconnect native acceptance.

steps.expr: "\\[enemysync\\] client hit claim connection=(?P<connection>\\d+) seq=(?P<seq>\\d+) epoch=(?P<epoch>\\d+) netId=(?P<netId>\\d+) objectId=(?P<objectId>\\d+) attackId=(?P<attackId>\\d+) damage=(?P<damage>\\d+)"

"\\[enemysync\\] host hit claim connection=(?P<connection>\\d+) seq=(?P<seq>\\d+) epoch=(?P<epoch>\\d+) netId=(?P<netId>\\d+) objectId=(?P<objectId>\\d+) attackId=(?P<attackId>\\d+) damage=(?P<damage>\\d+) beforeHp=(?P<beforeHp>-?\\d+) afterHp=(?P<afterHp>-?\\d+) nativeOk=(?P<nativeOk>\\d+)"

steps.message: Client 1's ordinary combo did not produce real transmitted claims and host native attempts.

steps.expr: all(len([c for c in saved['claims_1'] if all(c[k] == h[k] for k in ('connection','seq','epoch','netId','objectId','attackId','damage'))]) == 1 for h in saved['attempts_1'])
steps.message: A host attempt has no unique corresponding immutable client hit.

steps.expr: all(len([other for other in saved['attempts_1'] if (other['connection'], other['seq']) == (h['connection'], h['seq'])]) == 1 for h in saved['attempts_1'])
steps.message: A claim identity was applied more than once.

steps.expr: any(int(h['nativeOk']) == 1 and int(h['beforeHp']) > int(h['damage']) > 0 and int(h['afterHp']) == int(h['beforeHp']) - int(h['damage']) for h in saved['attempts_1'])
steps.message: No nonlethal client claim produced its exact positive HP delta on a freshly observed host enemy.
Combat acceptance crossed a room epoch.
Client 2's ordinary combo did not produce real transmitted claims and host native attempts.

steps.expr: all(len([c for c in saved['claims_2'] if all(c[k] == h[k] for k in ('connection','seq','epoch','netId','objectId','attackId','damage'))]) == 1 for h in saved['attempts_2'])
steps.message: A host attempt has no unique corresponding immutable client hit.

steps.expr: all(len([other for other in saved['attempts_2'] if (other['connection'], other['seq']) == (h['connection'], h['seq'])]) == 1 for h in saved['attempts_2'])
steps.message: A claim identity was applied more than once.

steps.expr: any(int(h['nativeOk']) == 1 and int(h['beforeHp']) > int(h['damage']) > 0 and int(h['afterHp']) == int(h['beforeHp']) - int(h['damage']) for h in saved['attempts_2'])
steps.message: No nonlethal client claim produced its exact positive HP delta on a freshly observed host enemy.
Combat acceptance crossed a room epoch.
